evidence.title: Dog Jam
evidence.text: Dog Jam is an annual rock festival held at Ford Park in Beaumont, Texas since 2001.

evidence.title: Dog Jam
evidence.text: It is sponsored by local rock radio station KIOC Big Dog 106 and Bud Light.

evidence.title: Dog Jam
evidence.text: Previous bands to play there include Default, 3 Doors Down, Breaking Benjamin, Korn, Droid, Five Finger Death Punch, Hellyeah, Element Eighty, Shinedown, and Staind.

evidence.title: Dive Bar Tour
evidence.text: The Dive Bar Tour, sponsored by Bud Light, was a promotional tour by American singer Lady Gaga, in support of her fifth studio album "Joanne" (2016).

evidence.title: Dive Bar Tour
evidence.text: The tour visited three dive bars in the United States, on October 5, 20 and 27.

evidence.title: Dive Bar Tour
evidence.text: All performances were live streamed on Bud Light's Facebook page, as well as Gaga's.

evidence.title: Ulterior Emotions
evidence.text: Ulterior Emotions was an album released in 2002 by Budweiser as part of their "Bud Light Institute" advertising campaign.

evidence.title: Ulterior Emotions
evidence.text: The album was a giveaway available to purchase on their website.

evidence.title: Ulterior Emotions
evidence.text: Also, for a time, you could download the song "You're Beautiful (Can I Go Up North This Weekend?)"

evidence.title: Ulterior Emotions
evidence.text: Lyrics were included with the album.

evidence.title: Bud Bowl
evidence.text: The Bud Bowl was a stop motion animated Super Bowl advertising campaign first aired in 1989, and sporadically during the 1990s.

evidence.title: Bud Bowl
evidence.text: It served as an advertisement for Anheuser-Busch's Budweiser family of beers.

evidence.title: Bud Bowl
evidence.text: It featured anthropomorphized Budweiser bottles playing a football game against Bud Light bottles.

evidence.title: Alex the Dog
evidence.text: Alex the Dog was the advertising mascot for Stroh's beer in the 1980s and precursor to Budweiser's Spuds MacKenzie.

evidence.title: Alex the Dog
evidence.text: At the peak of his career, Alex appeared in parades, on "Good Morning America", and the "Today" show.

evidence.title: Alex the Dog
evidence.text: He even inspired a series of toys, posters, cologne, shampoo and hand lotion.

evidence.title: Alex the Dog
evidence.text: Hip-hop artist Tone Loc referenced Alex the Dog in his song "Funky Cold Medina".
